Stop.bash: runtime="$(command -v bun || command -v node)"; root="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)"; "$runtime" "$root/scripts/stop-check.ts"
Stop.powershell: $root = git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>$null; if (-not $root) { $root = (Get-Location).Path }; $runtime = Get-Command bun -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if (-not $runtime) { $runtime = Get-Command node -ErrorAction Stop }; & $runtime.Source (Join-Path $root 'scripts/stop-check.ts')
